workItems.title: Command authority, atomic rejection and duplicate protection
workItems.remaining: Only Move, Interact and AdvanceClock payloads exist. No production actions, resumable reaction transaction or network authentication.
workItems.acceptance: Rejected requests preserve state/RNG; retries cannot repeat committed effects.

workItems.title: Versioned snapshots, save/load and explicit recovery
workItems.remaining: Snapshot currently holds fixture actors/objects/tokens. Full character, inventory, jobs, effects, encounters and migration remain.
workItems.acceptance: Persist every authoritative field; resume without duplicate awards; corrupt input cannot overwrite valid evidence.

workItems.title: Versioned random-state primitive
workItems.remaining: xorshift32 sequence/state exists; dice mapping, probability preservation, draw ownership and replay trace do not.
workItems.acceptance: Known vectors and restored state agree; later legal dice selection consumes the declared draws only.

workItems.title: Fixture clock and synthetic world interaction
workItems.remaining: Manual abstract ticks, 5x5 orthogonal cells and one token are test data; no production time, movement or inventory units.
workItems.acceptance: Keep fixture proofs distinct from real-time progression, terrain legality and item accounting.

workItems.title: Content identity, source precedence and visibility
workItems.remaining: Need typed definitions and source-qualified IDs, operation support checks, null/unknown handling and public/internal projections.
workItems.acceptance: No name-based grants, silent defaults, pending-effect execution or secret leakage.

workItems.title: Task checks and degrees
workItems.remaining: Declared d20 and modifier only; no proficiency/advantage selection, RNG, command or consequences.
workItems.acceptance: Boundary DC +/-10 and natural shifts; collapse degrees only when the task directs it.

workItems.title: Attack hit and critical determination
workItems.remaining: No target/weapon legality or damage dice application. Caller supplies eligible critical threshold.
workItems.acceptance: Meet AC; natural 1/20; wider critical range still requires a hit where specified.

workItems.title: Ordinary saves and literal failure margins
workItems.remaining: No saving-throw proficiency, immunity/automatic failure or source-specific outcomes.
workItems.acceptance: Binary meet-DC with no generic natural shift; retain exact margin.

workItems.title: Opposed totals and unchanged ties
workItems.remaining: No opposed-action legality, modifier derivation or resulting state change.
workItems.acceptance: Higher total wins; tie preserves state; do not import task natural shifts.

workItems.title: Dice selection, modifiers, automatic results and units
workItems.remaining: Select advantage/disadvantage, proficiency/expertise, legal modifiers, rounding and source-specific automatic outcomes.
workItems.acceptance: One advantage plus one disadvantage cancels regardless of counts; negative modifiers survive; automatic failure has no invented rolled margin.

workItems.title: Ability scores, proficiency and chronological base HP
sources: character:Abilities and training; Gain a level
workItems.remaining: Shared numeric character foundation, level history, per-level HP floors and current/max distinction.
workItems.acceptance: Scores8/13/16 => -1/+1/+3; PB uses total level; recompute HP floors individually; a capacity increase does not heal.

workItems.title: Creation, training, class entry and multiclass resources
sources: character:Begin a character sheet; Multiclass entry and class features; One shared RP pool
workItems.remaining: Ordered choices, duplicate training, class eligibility, actual kits, RP contributors and per-class access.
workItems.acceptance: No second maximum-HD first level, duplicated PB, free equipment or rank access from pooled RP.

workItems.title: Advancement, ASIs, acquisition and retraining
workItems.remaining: Process one earned level at a time, exact class schedules and explicit replacement procedures; no general free respec.
workItems.acceptance: Each acquisition consumed once; gates use own class level; no rest/healing on advancement.

workItems.title: Ancestries, variants, backgrounds and languages
sources: language:Choose starting languages; Learn a language
workItems.remaining: Preserve complete traits and choices, 14 ancestries/45 variants/20 backgrounds, training and communication records.
workItems.acceptance: One actual variant, no alternate-source stacking; unresolved feature stays explicit.

workItems.title: Class engines, cards and specializations
workItems.remaining: 17 distinct engines and their card payloads, resource lifecycles and exceptions; names/data are not execution.
workItems.acceptance: Every selected card has eligibility, payment, timing, effect and replay cases; preserve protected class differences.

workItems.title: Feats and source-specific grants
workItems.remaining: 335 original identities; distinguish retained reviewed entries, authored candidates and null wrappers. Follow current exact-review gates.
workItems.acceptance: No ability granted by label; prerequisites and full payload audited; null/pending payload rejected.

workItems.title: Direct movement and running
workItems.remaining: Choose direct-control geometry, time/pace, collision/traversal and follower rules. Tactical Dash does not define running input.
workItems.acceptance: Legal movement uses shared world state and cannot bypass occupancy or advance incompatible work.

workItems.title: Jumping, climbing, swimming and falling
workItems.remaining: Falling has bounded source procedures; direct jump/landing and several traversal policies still need decisions. Environment draft is not adoption.
workItems.acceptance: No crossing solid barriers or illegal landing; preserve fall/encounter clocks and movement ownership.

workItems.title: Open, unlock, examine, dig and mark
sources: equipment_items:Traps and restraints; Travel and practical tools
workItems.remaining: Locks/tools and route mapping have sources; persistent world interactions need IDs, ranges, quantities and repeat-use rules. Exposed-node mining grants no general excavation.
workItems.acceptance: Open/deplete once; revisit/reload preserves state; map marker is distinct from route discovery; unsupported digging is visible.

workItems.title: Sight, stealth, investigation and discoveries
workItems.remaining: Per-observer knowledge, light/senses, visibility, line of effect, hidden location and persistent discoveries.
workItems.acceptance: Known location does not imply sight; hidden/internal information remains filtered.

workItems.title: Routes, travel, scouting and finite sites
workItems.remaining: Route state, discoveries, actual distance/time, finite site stock and legal random events.
workItems.acceptance: Site depletion and travel progress survive save/reload; route mapping does not replace direct exploration.

workItems.title: Hazards, weather, traps and environmental effects
workItems.remaining: Bind accepted hazard procedures individually; unresolved weather/swim/fire draft cannot supply silent production defaults.
workItems.acceptance: Legal exposure causes one scheduled consequence; no invented DCs or immunity bypass.

workItems.title: Encounter entry, exit, retreat and position continuity
workItems.remaining: State machine joining exploration and turn-based encounters; shared positions/resources, surprise, reinforcements and escape.
workItems.acceptance: No free movement, clock duplication, cooldown refresh or item duplication across mode changes.

workItems.title: Mounts, vehicles, cargo and transport
sources: body:Carrying and Load; Extraction Class and Secure Cargo
workItems.remaining: Reviewed EX58 transport profiles need runtime bodies, seats, crews, cargo custody and traversal integration.
workItems.acceptance: Every body/item remains accounted for through transfers, retreat and repair.

workItems.title: Shared clock, initiative, turns and ordered events
sources: combat:Encounter and action resources; Time and event ordering
workItems.remaining: Source-qualified regular/extra turns, absolute deadlines, stable event order and mode conversion; prototype turn-based choice does not settle every clock.
workItems.acceptance: Regular markers run once; extra turns do not refresh ordinary reaction/recharge/death-save intervals; offscreen time is not duplicated.

workItems.title: Actions, reactions, Ready and interruption
sources: combat:Standard Actions; Ready; Stances; Maneuvers and ordinary attacks
workItems.remaining: Action budgets, grants, trigger eligibility, costs, staged choices and source-specific extra reactions.
workItems.acceptance: Illegal requests spend nothing; legal failed attempts pay their costs; one extra full Action cap and actual Ready timing.

workItems.title: Combat geometry, movement, range, cover and targets
sources: combat:Movement and geometry; Cover, sight, Hide and Search
workItems.remaining: Explicit geometry policy, occupancy, movement expenditure, modes, areas, line traces and legal targets; preserve intentional source abstractions.
workItems.acceptance: Mode changes retain expenditure, strongest terrain/cover only; no target selected through total obstruction.

workItems.title: Damage, defenses, HP, Wounds, injuries and death
sources: core:Resolve a damage event; Zero HP and recovery; Wounds and Critical state; Linked injuries
workItems.remaining: Damage dice/defense order plus life-state transitions; existing attack Critical flag is not damage resolution.
workItems.acceptance: Temporary HP first, instant death before Wounds, one Wound save per packet, pre-event penalties, no same-packet duplicate death failures.

workItems.title: Conditions, durations, stacking and control
workItems.remaining: Source records, inherited components, immunity suppression, hard-denial limits, periodic family arbitration and expiry.
workItems.acceptance: Suppress without resetting clocks; consumed loser ticks cannot bank; cure exactly the permitted records.

workItems.title: Healing, temporary/max HP, treatment and resurrection
sources: core:Zero HP and recovery; Ordinary Wound treatment
workItems.remaining: Separate real/max/temp HP, finite healing, treatment jobs, revival eligibility and body/soul/cost conditions.
workItems.acceptance: Capacity is not healing; dead is not downed; Wounds and independent conditions are not silently cured.

workItems.title: Spell identity, placement, acquisition and preparation
sources: spell:What owns each decision; Select a spell
canon_rank9:entries and canonicalProcedure override for ten identities
workItems.remaining: 848 ordinary identities have multiple placement/access records and varying authored scopes; exact current procedures must be bound per identity.
workItems.acceptance: Rank/school/known/prepared/target eligibility stays distinct; more RP cannot unlock access.

workItems.title: Casting, concentration, RP, strain and rituals
sources: spell:Resolve a cast at the table; Counterspell checks and interruption
workItems.remaining: Finite payment, components, interruptions, concentration slots, maintenance, repetition and named resource tracks.
workItems.acceptance: No unpaid effect, repeated start pulse, double concentration or merging unrelated Strain tracks.

workItems.title: Summons, constructed devices, forms and temporal effects
workItems.remaining: Source-specific commands, body identity/custody, shared caps, persistence, restoration and parent history. Recruited workers are a separate role.
workItems.acceptance: No duplicate creature/item/resources, unlimited restore loops or clock replays; preserve pending temporal gates.

workItems.title: Creature statistics, bosses, AI and encounter inputs
workItems.remaining: Complete creature actions/defenses, boss exceptions, encounter inputs and AI selecting legal commands; authored stats are not executable AI.
workItems.acceptance: Same legality path for humans/AI; no hidden-info omniscience or inferred generic boss immunities.

workItems.title: Inventory, equipment, currency, reservations and custody
workItems.remaining: Real stacks/lots/bundles, hands, containers, charges, Load, prices and ownership; synthetic Tokens is not this inventory.
workItems.acceptance: No double spend/output, source nulls preserved, bundle quantities correct, each physical body counted once.

workItems.title: Expedition roster, worker assignments and scheduler
workItems.remaining: Party workers versus summoned units, assigned activity/location/start/end, milestones, interruptions and permitted AI travel.
workItems.acceptance: No incompatible simultaneous work; advance one interval or equivalent chunks with identical ordered results.

workItems.title: Supply, food/water, camps, rest and pressure
workItems.remaining: Real finite provisions, support, spoilage, fatigue/rest debt, valid recovery location/time and pressure exposure.
workItems.acceptance: No duplicate elapsed hours, unearned recovery or resource refresh by opening a menu/declaring a scene.

workItems.title: Crafting work orders and recipe execution
sources: craft:One work order, one batch; The crafting check; Quality and finite output; Mishaps
workItems.remaining: 687 source recipes/433 public projections; framework and individual output effects are separate executable dependencies.
workItems.acceptance: Reserve/commit actual materials once, honor active time and interruption, quality/yield/failure/salvage and allowed output effect.

workItems.title: Harvesting, foraging, gathering and preservation
sources: craft:Identify and harvest; Preservation and spoilage
workItems.remaining: Finite source opportunity, actual material identity/quality, access/tools, one claim and spoilage protection.
workItems.acceptance: No repeated harvest from exhausted stock or duplicate material/food conversion.

workItems.title: Fishing and unattended trap lifecycle
sources: fishing:Start one attempt; The one-shot unattended Trap
workItems.remaining: Source already specifies reservation, commitment, setup/check/retrieval, interruptions and one-shot passive Trap; implement scheduler/world/worker integration.
workItems.acceptance: Before commitment release unspent reservations only; afterward no bait/opportunity refund; trap resolves once and still needs actual retrieval.

workItems.title: Mining and deposit extraction
sources: mining:Choose the procedure; Record and resolve the deposit
workItems.remaining: Prospecting, assay, exposed finite deposit extraction and physical access; no general tunnel/excavation rate supplied.
workItems.acceptance: One prior-selected finite claim, actual tools/time/body constraints; no arbitrary dig capability inferred.

workItems.title: Farming and agricultural companion work
workItems.remaining: No complete ordinary crop/job procedure located in bounded reviewed sources. Need crop/site/input/time/yield/season/failure rules and AI assignment scope.
workItems.acceptance: Explicit source decision before growth or yield implementation; Druidcraft does not replace farming.

workItems.title: Research, discovery, training and progression
workItems.remaining: Existing-formula research has evidence/time/check/retry/copy rules; novel recipes are proposals, not auto-created powers.
workItems.acceptance: No unsupported recipe grants; consume finite resources/time, persist progress and acquisition once.

workItems.title: Haven, markets, settlement, rewards and next descent
workItems.remaining: Valuation, custody/sale, claims/tax, work/services, XP/rewards and return preparation use one ledger.
workItems.acceptance: No duplicate loot/currency or repeated settlement rewards; preparations affect next expedition.

workItems.title: Social, language, reputation and factions
sources: language:Understand, translate or decipher; Communicate in a scene
workItems.remaining: Declared goals/checks, actual communication, relationship records, standing, agreements and finite faction work.
workItems.acceptance: No forced player beliefs, hidden data exposure or invented standing from a descriptive label.

workItems.title: World clocks, history, geography, quests and endings
workItems.remaining: Bind operative campaign/cosmology contracts by exact scope; authoritative lore is not an implemented quest/world-state machine.
workItems.acceptance: Cycle/endgame triggers and lasting consequences persist; public knowledge stays distinct from internal world truth.

workItems.title: Connected explore/encounter/acquire/manage loop
workItems.remaining: First demonstrate the connected simulation headlessly, with actual source-bound content and save/resume; Unity follows the C# phase.
workItems.acceptance: Explore -> encounter -> acquire -> assign/craft/research -> prepare -> explore again; no reset or duplication at boundaries. Dependencies mean source-bound minimum slices, not completion of every boss or area.

workItems.title: Automated scenarios, parity and balance evidence
workItems.remaining: 60 C# cases and8 package checks cover current small scope. Need independent rule vectors, cross-system scenarios and actual human/balance evidence later.
workItems.acceptance: Count actual discoveries/passes; source-model validation is not a C# pass; no completion percentage from test count.

workItems.remaining: Pure query/explanation contracts and source labels can be designed in C#; visuals/input/audio/accessibility and licensing/credits remain separate product work.
workItems.acceptance: Presentation reads the same resolver; no second rules implementation; Unity integration remains deferred.
